ZWE.note: Statement says nothing on authentication services.
Statement does not describe any link between the civil register and the ID system.
No count or share of the population holding a national ID is given.
No number issued at birth is described.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the national ID number is mentioned.
No statement on the national ID system's issuance, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: Zimbabwe's Deputy Minister told UNHCR's 75th ExCom that all migrants in Zimbabwe, including refugees, have access to birth and national identity card registration.
